description: Inbox watchdog: triage incoming Gmail against your rules, Slack-ping you with a deep link on what needs attention, and clear Promotions/Social/Spam in one tap.

sections.label: Triage & alerts
sections.description: Starting defaults for a new user. Everything here can be changed later in the app on the Rules screen, which then owns the value.

fields.label: Ping me about
fields.description: Which mail is worth interrupting you for.

options.label: Urgent only
options.description: Only mail Sentry classifies as urgent.

options.label: Urgent + needs a reply
options.description: Also ping for mail that's waiting on an answer from you.

fields.label: Draft replies automatically
fields.description: Write a reply in your voice as soon as mail is flagged, so the notification carries a ready-to-send draft. Nothing is ever sent without your approval.

features: Teach it in plain language what to watch for — it turns your words into triage rules, grounded in your real inbox
Learns how you actually communicate: VIPs you correspond with + your writing voice
AI triage of incoming Gmail into urgent / needs-reply / FYI
Notify via Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, or Discord — with a ready-to-send reply in your voice
Approve & send a reply in one tap, from the app or straight from the notification
Daily inbox report of what needs attention + the replies waiting
Auto-file mail by sender/subject with label rules
One-tap bulk clear of Promotions, Social, and Spam
Runs on a schedule (every 5 minutes by default)

how_to_capture: Run `cd frontend && npm run screenshots` — regenerates every declared file at 2x from the live widget.
Re-run it after any widget change; the PNGs are build output, not hand-captured art.
best_practices: Element screenshots at deviceScaleFactor 2 — exactly 170×170 / 360×170 / 360×360 at 2x, no page chrome.
Data comes from frontend/tests/fixtures/widget-marketing.json: plausible people, companies and asks.
The fixture uses pre-rendered relative strings ('4m ago'), so re-running gives byte-identical files.
Never ship 'test'/'foo'/'lorem'/'example.com'/'John Doe' — obvious placeholder data reads as unfinished.

core_action.definition_of_done: A new email that needs a reply arrives; within a scan the user gets a notification on their channel (Slack/WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord) carrying a reply drafted in their own voice and a one-tap approve link. Tapping it (or opening the app) lands on the email with Approve & Send, which really sends the reply through Gmail (in-thread) and marks it done — or shows a clear connect-Gmail/reconnect-channel prompt when an integration is not connected (never a faked success). Urgent mail is flagged in the dashboard and widget, matching mail is auto-filed by label rules, a daily digest reports what's waiting, and Promotions/Social/Spam clear in one tap.
